changeSet.sql:
CREATE TABLE entry_metric_goal ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, updated_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, entry_goal_id BIGINT NOT NULL, metric_type_id BIGINT NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT fk_metric_goal_entry_goal FOREIGN KEY (entry_goal_id) REFERENCES diary_entry_goal (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, CONSTRAINT fk_metric_goal_type FOREIGN KEY (metric_type_id) REFERENCES dictionary_item (id) );
CREATE INDEX idx_metric_goal_entry_goal ON entry_metric_goal (entry_goal_id); CREATE INDEX idx_metric_goal_type ON entry_metric_goal (metric_type_id);
